cases: TC-1 · REQ-1, REQ-2, AC-1 credit-weighted GPA; round only the final quotient half-even (3.125 ties to 3.12 because 2 is even; 3.13 is wrong) · calculateGpa({courses:[{gradePoints:"3.7",credits:"3"},{gradePoints:"3.3",credits:"3"},{gradePoints:"2.0",credits:"2"}]}); (3.7*3+3.3*3+2.0*2)/8=25/8=3.125 → {gpa:"3.12"}

TC-2 · REQ-2, REQ-3, AC-2 exact decimal, not binary float; 2.675 ties to 2.68 because 8 is even; 2.67 fails · calculateGpa({courses:[{gradePoints:"4.0",credits:"1"},{gradePoints:"3.0",credits:"1"},{gradePoints:"2.0",credits:"1"},{gradePoints:"1.7",credits:"1"}]}); 10.7/4=2.675 → {gpa:"2.68"}
TC-3 · REQ-4, AC-3 empty list is zero credits: no GPA, no division, not 0.00, not an error · calculateGpa({courses:[]}) → {gpa:null}

TC-4 · REQ-4 zero total credits with courses present (zero, beside the empty list); do not return 0.00 or divide · calculateGpa({courses:[{gradePoints:"4.0",credits:"0"},{gradePoints:"3.0",credits:"0"}]}); credit sum 0 → {gpa:null}

TC-5 · REQ-1, REQ-2 single course; integer decimal strings; non-tie round up, not truncation · calculateGpa({courses:[{gradePoints:"2",credits:"3"}]}); 2/3=0.666... nearer 0.67 than 0.66 → {gpa:"0.67"}

TC-6 · REQ-2 even-digit halfway 3.125, one step below; not a tie · calculateGpa({courses:[{gradePoints:"3.1249",credits:"1"}]}); 3.1249<3.125 so nearer 3.12; rounding to 3dp first then half-up would give 3.13 → {gpa:"3.12"}

TC-7 · REQ-2 even-digit halfway 3.125, one step above; not a tie · calculateGpa({courses:[{gradePoints:"3.1251",credits:"1"}]}); 3.1251>3.125 so nearer 3.13; ignoring the extra digit and half-even would give 3.12 → {gpa:"3.13"}

TC-8 · REQ-2 odd-digit halfway 2.675, one step below; not a tie · calculateGpa({courses:[{gradePoints:"2.6749",credits:"1"}]}); 2.6749<2.675 so nearer 2.67; rounding to 3dp first yields 2.675 then 2.68 → {gpa:"2.67"}
TC-9 · REQ-2 odd-digit halfway 2.675, one step above; not a tie · calculateGpa({courses:[{gradePoints:"2.6751",credits:"1"}]}); 2.6751>2.675 so nearer 2.68; truncation would give 2.67 → {gpa:"2.68"}

TC-10 · REQ-2 round only the final quotient, not the intermediate product · calculateGpa({courses:[{gradePoints:"3.335",credits:"3"}]}); 3.335*3=10.005; 10.005/3=3.335 ties to 3.34 because 4 is even; round2(10.005)=10.00 then /3 would give 3.33 → {gpa:"3.34"}
TC-11 · REQ-1 a zero quotient is GPA 0.00, not an absent GPA · calculateGpa({courses:[{gradePoints:"0",credits:"1"},{gradePoints:"0.0",credits:"2"}]}); (0*1+0*2)/3=0 → {gpa:"0.00"}
TC-12 · unknown field on the input object · calculateGpa({courses:[{gradePoints:"4",credits:"1"}],extra:"x"}) → throws Error "unknown field: extra"

TC-13 · unknown field on the first course · calculateGpa({courses:[{gradePoints:"4.0",credits:"1",note:"a"},{gradePoints:"3.0",credits:"1"},{gradePoints:"2.0",credits:"1"}]}) → throws Error "unknown field: note"

TC-14 · unknown field on the middle course · calculateGpa({courses:[{gradePoints:"4.0",credits:"1"},{gradePoints:"3.0",credits:"1",note:"b"},{gradePoints:"2.0",credits:"1"}]}) → throws Error "unknown field: note"

TC-15 · unknown field on the last course · calculateGpa({courses:[{gradePoints:"4.0",credits:"1"},{gradePoints:"3.0",credits:"1"},{gradePoints:"2.0",credits:"1",note:"c"}]}) → throws Error "unknown field: note"

TC-16 · invalid decimal, including when the value is a number; bad item in the middle · calculateGpa({courses:[{gradePoints:"4.0",credits:"1"},{gradePoints:2.675,credits:"1"},{gradePoints:"3.0",credits:"1"}]}) → throws Error "invalid decimal: gradePoints"
